Dilo 0.13.0

The first public release of Dilo. Signed and notarized by Apple.

  • Dilo Basic is free: dictate with the fn key in any app, in 19 languages, fully on your Mac.
  • Dilo Pro: meetings without bots, voice notes, Ask your meetings, AI cleanup, ten voice commands, the built-in local AI model and export. One payment, every future version included. Paste your key in Settings > License.
  • Automatic updates: Dilo now checks for new versions on its own and never interrupts a dictation or a meeting to install. You can also use Check for Updates in the menu bar icon.
